name: plumbline-mcp

tools.name: list_pools
tools.description: List Sui DeepBook v3 spot pools with base/quote assets and trading params (tick, lot, min size in human units). Optional filter by asset symbol. Education/information only; not financial advice. Read-only public data, may be delayed or wrong.

asset.description: Only pools containing this asset symbol, e.g. SUI or USDC

include_ids.description: Include pool object IDs and coin types (longer output)

tools.name: get_mid_price
tools.description: Best bid, best ask, mid price and spread (abs and bps) for a DeepBook pool, plus last trade price. Education/information only; not financial advice. Read-only public data, may be delayed or wrong.

pool.description: DeepBook pool name BASE_QUOTE, e.g. SUI_USDC (case-insensitive; '/' or '-' also accepted)

tools.name: get_order_book
tools.description: Order book for a DeepBook pool: top N price levels per side and cumulative liquidity (base qty and quote notional) within ±X% of mid. Education/information only; not financial advice. Read-only public data, may be delayed or wrong.

pool.description: DeepBook pool name BASE_QUOTE, e.g. SUI_USDC (case-insensitive; '/' or '-' also accepted)

levels.description: Price levels to return per side (1-100, default 10)

within_pct.description: Depth bands as % distance from mid, e.g. [0.5, 1, 2]

tools.name: get_volume
tools.description: 24h volume, high/low, last price and % change for one DeepBook pool, or the top pools by 24h quote volume if no pool is given. Set window_hours for a custom trailing window (single pool). Education/information only; not financial advice. Read-only public data, may be delayed or wrong.

pool.description: DeepBook pool name BASE_QUOTE, e.g. SUI_USDC (case-insensitive; '/' or '-' also accepted)

window_hours.description: Trailing window in hours (default 24). Non-24 values need a pool.

top.description: When no pool is given: how many pools to return (default 10)

tools.name: get_pool_params
tools.description: Taker/maker fees, DEEP stake required, tick/lot/min size, whitelist/stable flags and vault balances for a DeepBook pool. Reads the live on-chain Pool object via Sui GraphQL; falls back to indexer pool-creation values if GraphQL is unavailable. Education/information only; not financial advice. Read-only public data, may be delayed or wrong.

pool.description: DeepBook pool name BASE_QUOTE, e.g. SUI_USDC (case-insensitive; '/' or '-' also accepted)

tools.name: get_recent_trades
tools.description: Most recent fills in a DeepBook pool (newest first): time, taker side, price, base and quote size. Optional time range. Education/information only; not financial advice. Read-only public data, may be delayed or wrong.

pool.description: DeepBook pool name BASE_QUOTE, e.g. SUI_USDC (case-insensitive; '/' or '-' also accepted)

tools.name: get_ohlcv
tools.description: OHLCV candles for a DeepBook pool (oldest first). Intervals: 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d, 1w. Volume is in the base asset. Education/information only; not financial advice. Read-only public data, may be delayed or wrong.

pool.description: DeepBook pool name BASE_QUOTE, e.g. SUI_USDC (case-insensitive; '/' or '-' also accepted)

tools.name: get_indexer_status
tools.description: Health and freshness of the public DeepBook indexer (status, latest checkpoint, server time). Use when data looks stale. Education/information only; not financial advice. Read-only public data, may be delayed or wrong.

instructions: Plumbline: read-only Sui DeepBook v3 market data (pools, mid, depth, volume, fees, trades, OHLCV). Pool names are BASE_QUOTE, e.g. SUI_USDC; call list_pools first if unsure. No keys, no wallets, no trading. Education/information only; not financial advice. Read-only public data, may be delayed or wrong.
